reuse.why: Extends the shared isSkippedByMonthWideAction rule, but writes its own `#fixed` regex instead of using the tag parser in shared/tags.ts (extractTagsFromText), whose tokenization rules differ.

duplication.why: Skip rule added once; the notes JOIN is repeated in getBudgetData and getMonthWideCategories because those two queries already existed separately.

placement.why: The rule sits in the single month-wide skip predicate in budget/actions.ts; tag recognition, however, belongs to shared/tags.ts.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the two feeding queries, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: One predicate controls all month-wide actions; the ad hoc tag regex may drift from how tags are parsed elsewhere.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts hasFixedTag uses its own /(^|\s)#fixed(?![\w-])/ regex instead of shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: The tag regex is a re-implementation rather than a reshaped copy; the repeated JOIN is plain.

one_place.where: budget/actions.ts isSkippedByMonthWideAction (hasFixedTag), used by getMonthWideCategories for all month-wide actions and by copyPreviousMonth.
